name: Crimson Ritualist
summary: Learn the Blood Bolt cantrip, and bleed Hit Point Dice into a vial at a Long Rest that someone can drink to heal.

benefits.name: Blood Lash
benefits.summary: You learn the Blood Bolt cantrip; Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is its spellcasting ability.
benefits.text: You learn the Blood Bolt cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it (choose when you take this feat).

benefits.name: Bottled Life
benefits.summary: After a Long Rest, a 1-minute ritual spends up to PB Hit Point Dice into a vial; a Bonus Action to drink it heals the rolled dice plus the drinker's Constitution modifier.
benefits.text: When you finish a Long Rest you can perform a 1-minute ritual that moves some of your life essence into a vessel. Expend a number of Hit Point Dice up to your Proficiency Bonus and bleed into a vial of water or another liquid. As a Bonus Action, a creature can drink the vial: it rolls the Hit Dice you expended and regains Hit Points equal to the total rolled plus its Constitution modifier. The vial stays potent until you finish your next Long Rest.
